SECTION 1.1 · 教材 p.1SECTION 1.1 · Textbook p.1

复数Complex numbers

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

极形式、乘方与开方Polar form, powers, and roots

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

复数也能画成一支箭头。先找箭头有多长、朝哪里，再处理乘方和开方；角度会决定有几个不同的根。

Think of a complex number as an arrow. Find its length and direction first; powers and roots then become operations on lengths and angles.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

复数的模表示长度，辐角表示方向。乘法把长度相乘、角度相加；开 n 次方会出现 n 个等间隔根。

The modulus of a complex number is its distance from the origin. Its argument is its direction angle. Multiplication multiplies distances and adds angles. Taking an nth root gives n equally spaced roots.

z=reiθ,z1/n=r1/nei(θ+2kπ)/n
使用条件When it applies

z≠0；k=0,…,n−1。主辐角约定为 (−π,π]。

z≠0; k=0,…,n−1. We use (−π,π] as the range of the principal argument.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

由欧拉公式 eiθ=cosθ+isinθ，相乘得到 r1r2ei(θ1+θ2)。若 wn=z，则 |w|n=r，且 n\argw=θ+2kπ；只取连续的 n 个整数就穷尽互异根。

Euler's formula is eiθ=cosθ+isinθ. Multiplication then gives r1r2ei(θ1+θ2). If wn=z, then |w|n=r and n\argw=θ+2kπ. Taking any n consecutive integers lists every distinct root.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

求 z3=8i 的全部根。

Find all roots of z3=8i.

解答

Solution

8i=8eiπ/2，所以 zk=2ei(π/6+2kπ/3)，k=0,1,2。代回三次方都等于 8i。

Write 8i=8eiπ/2. The roots are therefore zk=2ei(π/6+2kπ/3), k=0,1,2. Cubing any one of them gives 8i.

记忆线索Memory cue

乘除用极式，求实虚部用代数式；求根记得分支。

Use polar form for multiplication and division. Use Cartesian form to find real and imaginary parts. List every branch when finding roots.

SECTION 1.2 · 教材 p.8SECTION 1.2 · Textbook p.8

复变函数与分支Complex functions and branches

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

平方根支点与黎曼面Square-root branch points and Riemann surfaces

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

沿着原点绕一圈，平方根可能变成原来的负数。先说明你在哪个区域、选哪一支，函数值才有唯一含义。

Going once around the origin can reverse the sign of a square root. Specify the region and the chosen branch before calculating a value.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

绕一个零点一周后函数值改变，说明这里是支点。对平方根，奇数阶零点或极点会使符号翻转；切开平面后可选单值分支，再将两张割面交叉粘合。

A point is a branch point if going once around it changes the function value. For a square root, a zero or pole of odd order reverses the sign. Cuts let us choose a single-valued branch. Two cut copies of the plane can then be joined crosswise.

(z−a)m⟼emπi(z−a)m
使用条件When it applies

在局部非零解析因子已选单值根时使用；无穷远需令 w=1/z 检查。

Use this argument after choosing a single-valued root of the locally nonzero analytic factor. At infinity, substitute w=1/z and check the point at zero.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

写 z−a=ρeiθ，绕一周令 θ→θ+2π。平方根因子变化为 eimπ=(−1)m，奇数翻号，偶数不翻号。

Write z−a=ρeiθ. One circuit changes the angle by θ→θ+2π. The square-root factor changes by eimπ=(−1)m: odd orders reverse its sign; even orders do not.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

z2−1 在哪里有支点？

Where are the branch points of z2−1?

解答

Solution

有限支点为 ±1。令 w=1/z 得 w−11−w2，w=0 附近为单值亚纯函数，因此无穷远不是支点。

The finite branch points are ±1. Substitution w=1/z gives w−11−w2, which is single-valued and meromorphic near w=0. Infinity is therefore not a branch point.

记忆线索Memory cue

支点看绕圈是否变值，不能把每个奇点都叫支点。

A branch point is detected by a change after a circuit. A singular point is not automatically a branch point.

SECTION 1.3 · 教材 p.13SECTION 1.3 · Textbook p.13

微分与解析函数Differentiation and analytic functions

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

柯西–黎曼条件与调和共轭Cauchy–Riemann equations and harmonic conjugates

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

实变量求导只沿一条直线，复变量求导却允许从任何方向靠近。先拆出实部和虚部，用两个偏导关系筛选候选点，再检查是否真的可导。

A complex derivative must agree along every approach direction. Split the function into real and imaginary parts, use two partial-derivative relations to find candidates, then check differentiability.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

复导数要求从任意方向逼近都得到同一值，比实函数可微更强。先分出 u,v，再检查两条 C–R 方程。解析要求在一个开邻域内处处可导。

A complex derivative must have the same limit from every direction. This is stronger than real differentiability. First separate u,v, then check both C–R equations. Analyticity means differentiability throughout an open neighborhood.

ux=vy,uy=−vx,f′=ux+ivx
使用条件When it applies

偏导在邻域连续时，C–R 条件对可导充分；只在一个点成立不等于在邻域解析。

When the partial derivatives are continuous in a neighborhood, the C–R equations are sufficient for complex differentiability. Holding at one point does not establish analyticity in a neighborhood.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

沿实增量得到 f′=ux+ivx；沿虚增量得到 f′=vy−iuy。两式相等给出 C–R。反过来，实二元可微展开 Δf=(ux+ivx)Δx+(uy+ivy)Δy+o(|Δz|)；用 C–R 合并成 (ux+ivx)Δz+o(|Δz|)。

An increment along the real axis gives f′=ux+ivx. An increment along the imaginary axis gives f′=vy−iuy. Equating these gives C–R. Conversely, real differentiability gives Δf=(ux+ivx)Δx+(uy+ivy)Δy+o(|Δz|). C–R combines this into (ux+ivx)Δz+o(|Δz|).

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

已知 u=x2−y2 且 f(0)=0，求 f。

Given u=x2−y2 and f(0)=0, find f.

解答

Solution

vy=2x 得 v=2xy+g(x)；vx=−uy=2y 得 g′=0。初值给常数零，故 f=z2。

From vy=2x we obtain v=2xy+g(x). Then vx=−uy=2y gives g′=0. The initial value makes the constant zero, so f=z2.

记忆线索Memory cue

先验调和，再用 C–R 积分，最后用初值定常数。

Check that the given part is harmonic. Integrate C–R to find the other part. Use the initial value to fix the constant.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

调和函数与正交曲线Harmonic functions and orthogonal curves

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

调和函数描述没有内部热源的稳定温度一类的场。把两个方向的二阶偏导相加，就能先检查题目是否属于这一类。

A harmonic function models a steady field with no interior source. Add its second partial derivatives to check whether a proposed function is harmonic.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

解析函数的实部与虚部都是调和函数；在导数非零的点，等实部与等虚部曲线垂直。

The real and imaginary parts of an analytic function are harmonic. Where its derivative is nonzero, the curves of constant real part and constant imaginary part meet at right angles.

Δu=Δv=0,∇u·∇v=0
使用条件When it applies

局部解析；讨论曲线切线时还要求 f′(z0)≠0。

The function is locally analytic. To discuss the curve tangents, also require f′(z0)≠0.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

对 ux=vy 求 x 导数，对 uy=−vx 求 y 导数，混合偏导抵消得到 uxx+uyy=0。又 uxvx+uyvy=vyvx−vxvy=0；非零梯度是等值线法向量，法向量垂直所以切线也垂直。

Differentiate ux=vy with respect to x and uy=−vx with respect to y. The mixed partial derivatives cancel, giving uxx+uyy=0. Also, uxvx+uyvy=vyvx−vxvy=0. Each nonzero gradient is normal to its level curve. Perpendicular normals give perpendicular tangents.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

f=z2 的两族等值线为什么垂直？

Why are the two families of level curves of f=z2 perpendicular?

解答

Solution

u=x2−y2,v=2xy，梯度内积 (2x)(2y)+(−2y)(2x)=0。原点是临界点，那里必须单独讨论，不能套非零梯度结论。

Here u=x2−y2,v=2xy. Their gradient dot product is (2x)(2y)+(−2y)(2x)=0. The origin is a critical point and needs separate treatment; the nonzero-gradient conclusion does not apply there.

记忆线索Memory cue

调和是必要条件；正交结论别漏临界点。

Harmonicity is a necessary condition. Check critical points before claiming orthogonality.

SECTION 1.4 · 教材 p.20SECTION 1.4 · Textbook p.20

复积分与柯西公式Complex integration and the Cauchy formula

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

柯西积分公式与积分估计Cauchy integral formula and integral bounds

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

一个闭合圈上的积分，可以告诉你圈内某一点的函数值或导数。先圈出分母对应的点，并检查它是否在路径内部。

An integral around a closed curve can give a function value or derivative inside. Locate the denominator’s special point first and check that it lies inside the curve.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

路径上含共轭、实部或虚部时，通常直接参数化；解析函数的闭路积分先看区域内奇点。柯西公式把积分转换成某点的函数值或导数。

If the integrand contains a conjugate, real part, or imaginary part, parameterizing the path is usually the direct approach. For a closed contour, first locate the singularities inside. The Cauchy formula turns an integral into a function value or derivative at one point.

∮Cf(z)(z−a)n+1dz=2πin!f(n)(a),|∫Cgdz|≤ML
使用条件When it applies

f 在正向简单闭曲线及其内部解析，a 在内部；估计中 M 是路径上模的上界，L 是路径长。

f is analytic on and inside a positively oriented simple closed curve; a is inside. In the estimate, M bounds the modulus on the path and L is its length.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

先由柯西定理把积分缩到 a 周围小圆。令 z−a=εeit，泰勒展开中只有 (z−a)−1 项积分不为零，其积分为 2πi。估计由 |∫gdz|≤∫|g||dz|≤ML 得到。

Cauchy's theorem lets us shrink the contour to a small circle around a. Set z−a=εeit. In the Taylor expansion, only the (z−a)−1 term has a nonzero integral, equal to 2πi. The estimate follows from |∫gdz|≤∫|g||dz|≤ML.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

求 ∮|z|=2ez/z3dz（逆时针）。

Evaluate ∮|z|=2ez/z3dz, counterclockwise.

解答

Solution

取 n=2,f=ez,a=0，结果为 2πif′′(0)/2!=πi。

Choose n=2,f=ez,a=0. The result is 2πif′′(0)/2!=πi.

记忆线索Memory cue

先判内部奇点，再匹配分母幂次，最后检查方向与阶乘。

Locate the enclosed singularities. Match the denominator power. Check the orientation and factorial.

SECTION 1.5 · 教材 p.27SECTION 1.5 · Textbook p.27

幂级数与奇点Power series and singularities

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

泰勒、洛朗展开及收敛环域Taylor and Laurent expansions and their annuli

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

展开式就是把难算的函数改写成一串容易处理的幂。先标出离展开中心最近的奇点；区域选错，即使算式看起来对，也不能使用。

A series replaces a function with manageable powers. Locate singularities around the expansion center first: the region determines which expansion is valid.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

同一个有理函数在不同环域有不同级数。先平移中心，再按距离中心的各个奇点划分圆环；每个因子都应变为绝对值小于一的几何级数。

The same rational function can have different series in different annuli. First shift the expansion center. Use the distances to the singularities to divide the plane into rings. Rewrite each factor as a geometric series whose ratio has modulus less than one.

11−w=∑n=0∞wn (|w|<1),R−1=lim supn→∞|an|1/n
使用条件When it applies

幂级数内部绝对收敛；边界要逐点检验。洛朗级数只在指定环域成立。

A power series converges absolutely inside its convergence disk. Check the boundary point by point. A Laurent series is valid only in its stated annulus.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

有限几何和为 (1−wN+1)/(1−w)，|w|<1 时余项趋零。根值判别对 an(z−z0)n 给 lim sup|an|1/n|z−z0|<1，所以得到收敛半径。

The finite geometric sum is (1−wN+1)/(1−w). Its remainder tends to zero when |w|<1. Applied to an(z−z0)n, the root test gives lim sup|an|1/n|z−z0|<1, which determines the radius of convergence.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

在 |z|>1 展开 1/(1+z)。

Expand 1/(1+z) in |z|>1.

解答

Solution

提取 z：1/(1+z)=z−1(1+z−1)−1=∑n=0∞(−1)nz−n−1，因 |z−1|<1。

Factor out z: 1/(1+z)=z−1(1+z−1)−1=∑n=0∞(−1)nz−n−1, since |z−1|<1.

记忆线索Memory cue

先画奇点距离，再决定展开变量是 z 还是 1/z。

Mark the singularity distances first. Then decide whether the small expansion variable is z or 1/z.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

可去、极点与本性奇点Removable singularities, poles, and essential singularities

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

分母为零，不一定就是极点：分子也可能抵消它。先展开或约去共同因子，再看还剩多少负次幂。

A zero denominator does not automatically mean a pole: the numerator may cancel it. Expand or cancel common factors, then inspect the remaining negative powers.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

洛朗级数的负幂部分决定孤立奇点类型。无穷远改用 w=1/z，但若有限奇点不断趋于无穷远，无穷远就不是孤立奇点。

The negative-power part of a Laurent series classifies an isolated singularity. At infinity, use w=1/z. If finite singularities continue out toward infinity, infinity is not isolated.

f(z)=∑n=−∞∞an(z−a)n
使用条件When it applies

必须先确认奇点孤立，才能使用这三类。

First verify that the singularity is isolated. Only then do these three categories apply.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

没有负幂时可补定义得到解析函数；有限个负幂且最低为 −m，则 (z−a)mf 在 a 解析且非零，故为 m 阶极点；无限多个负幂是本性奇点。

With no negative powers, adding a value at the point makes the function analytic. With finitely many negative powers and lowest power −m, (z−a)mf is analytic and nonzero at a, so the point is a pole of order m. Infinitely many negative powers mean an essential singularity.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

sinz/z 在原点是什么奇点？

What kind of singularity does sinz/z have at the origin?

解答

Solution

sinz/z=1−z2/3!+⋯，没有负幂；补 f(0)=1 即解析，因此可去。

The series sinz/z=1−z2/3!+⋯ has no negative powers. Defining f(0)=1 makes the function analytic, so the singularity is removable.

记忆线索Memory cue

先消零点，再判阶数；分母为零不一定是极点。

Cancel zeros before determining the order. A zero denominator does not always produce a pole.

SECTION 1.6 · 教材 p.40SECTION 1.6 · Textbook p.40

留数定理Residue theorem

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

留数与高阶极点Residues and poles of higher order

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

留数就是局部展开中负一次幂的系数。算围道积分时，先找圈内有哪些奇点，再逐个取这个系数。

The residue is the coefficient of the minus-first power in a local Laurent series. For a contour integral, locate the enclosed singularities and find that coefficient at each one.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

留数是洛朗展开中 (z−a)−1 的系数。简单极点用极限，高阶极点用求导，本性奇点通常展开后取系数。

A residue is the coefficient of (z−a)−1 in a Laurent expansion. Use a limit for a simple pole, derivatives for a higher-order pole, and usually a series coefficient for an essential singularity.

Resz=af=1(m−1)![dm−1dzm−1((z−a)mf)]z=a
使用条件When it applies

a 为 m 阶极点；正向闭路积分为 2πi 乘内部留数和。

a is a pole of order m. A positively oriented closed-contour integral equals 2πi times the sum of enclosed residues.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

把 g=(z−a)mf 作泰勒展开，其第 m−1 次项除以 (z−a)m 后正好成为 (z−a)−1，系数为 g(m−1)(a)/(m−1)!。其余幂次沿小圆积分均为零。

Taylor-expand g=(z−a)mf. Its term of degree m−1 becomes (z−a)−1 after division by (z−a)m, with coefficient g(m−1)(a)/(m−1)!. All other powers integrate to zero on a small circle.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

求 ez/(z−1)2 在 z=1 的留数。

Find the residue of ez/(z−1)2 at z=1.

解答

Solution

令 g=ez，留数为 g′(1)=e。不是 e1/2!：二阶极点求一次导数、除 1!。

Let g=ez. The residue is g′(1)=e. It is not e1/2!: a second-order pole needs one derivative and division by 1!.

记忆线索Memory cue

留数只取负一次；极点阶数减一再求导。

Only the power minus one determines the residue. Subtract one from the pole order to get the derivative order.

SECTION 1.7 · 教材 p.45SECTION 1.7 · Textbook p.45

留数计算实积分Real integrals by residues

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

实积分的围道选择Choosing a contour for a real integral

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

实轴积分可以借助复平面中的闭合路线来算。路线要让多出来的一段能算、或能证明趋近于零；先看指数衰减和极点的位置。

Close a real integral along a suitable route in the complex plane. Choose the route by locating poles and finding where any exponential decays, then control the added pieces.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

有理函数衰减够快时闭合上半圆；带 eikx 时根据 k 的符号选择半平面；三角积分令 z=eiθ；幂函数可使用扇形或钥匙孔围道。

For a sufficiently decaying rational function, close with an upper semicircle. With eikx, choose the half-plane from the sign of k. For a trigonometric integral, set z=eiθ. Powers may suggest a sector or keyhole contour.

∫−∞∞R(x)eikxdx=2πi∑Ima>0Resz=a(R(z)eikz)
使用条件When it applies

上式要求 k>0、实轴无极点及大圆弧积分消失。实轴有极点时先说明是否取主值，小凹口会贡献半留数。

The displayed formula requires k>0, no poles on the real axis, and a vanishing large-arc integral. With real-axis poles, state whether a principal value is intended. A small indentation contributes half a residue term.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

eik(x+iy)=eikx−ky，k>0 时上半平面衰减。由留数定理将闭路拆为实轴和大圆弧，再令圆弧积分趋零即可。若上方绕过实轴单极点 a，顺时针小半圆贡献 −iπResaf。

Since eik(x+iy)=eikx−ky, the exponential decays in the upper half-plane when k>0. Split the closed contour into the real-axis segment and large arc, apply residues, then let the arc integral vanish. Passing above a simple real-axis pole a uses a clockwise small semicircle, which contributes −iπResaf.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

求 ∫−∞∞dx/(x2+a2)，a>0。

Evaluate ∫−∞∞dx/(x2+a2) for a>0.

解答

Solution

上半平面只有 ia，留数 1/(2ia)；大圆弧为 O(1/R)，所以结果为 2πi/(2ia)=π/a。

Only ia lies in the upper half-plane. Its residue is 1/(2ia). The large-arc contribution is O(1/R), so the answer is 2πi/(2ia)=π/a.

记忆线索Memory cue

先验收敛与实轴极点，再选围道；半轴偶函数记得除二。

Check convergence and real-axis poles before choosing the contour. For an even integrand, remember to halve the whole-line result.

SECTION 1.8 · 教材 p.58SECTION 1.8 · Textbook p.58

色散关系Dispersion relations

本节无书后习题No end-of-section exercises
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

实部与虚部的 Hilbert 变换联系Hilbert-transform relations between real and imaginary parts

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

解析性会把实部与虚部联系起来，它们并不是两个可随意指定的函数。先检查所在半平面、无穷远衰减以及主值积分的约定。

Analyticity links the real and imaginary parts; they cannot be prescribed independently. Check the half-plane, decay at infinity, and principal-value convention first.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

上半平面解析且在无穷远衰减的函数，其边界实部与虚部不是独立的。绕实轴点的小半圆产生半留数，从而得到主值公式。

If a function is analytic in the upper half-plane and decays at infinity, its boundary real and imaginary parts are linked. A small semicircle around a real-axis point supplies half a residue term and leads to a principal-value formula.

u(x)=1πPV∫−∞∞v(t)t−xdt,v(x)=−1πPV∫−∞∞u(t)t−xdt
使用条件When it applies

f 在闭上半平面满足相应解析性、边界正则性及足够衰减；积分为柯西主值。

f must satisfy the appropriate analyticity, boundary regularity, and decay conditions in the closed upper half-plane. The integrals are Cauchy principal values.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

从上方绕开 x，闭路无极点，小半圆积分趋 −iπf(x)，大圆弧趋零，故 PV∫f(t)/(t−x)dt=iπf(x)。取实虚部：主值实部为 −πv(x)，主值虚部为 πu(x)，整理得公式。

Indent above x. There are no enclosed poles; the small arc tends to −iπf(x) and the large arc tends to zero. Hence PV∫f(t)/(t−x)dt=iπf(x). The real part of the principal-value integral is −πv(x) and the imaginary part is πu(x). Rearranging gives the formulas.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

f(z)=1/(z+i) 满足上半平面条件吗？

Does f(z)=1/(z+i) satisfy the upper-half-plane conditions?

解答

Solution

唯一极点 −i 在下半平面，且 f=O(1/z)。实轴上 u=x/(x2+1),v=−1/(x2+1)，它们满足上述主值联系。

Its only pole −i is in the lower half-plane, and f=O(1/z). On the real axis, u=x/(x2+1),v=−1/(x2+1). These parts satisfy the stated principal-value relations.

记忆线索Memory cue

正负号取决于解析半平面和核的方向；别只背 Hilbert 变换名称。

The signs depend on the analytic half-plane and the direction of the kernel. Learn those choices along with the Hilbert-transform name.

复数Complex numbers

5 道主编号题5 numbered exercises
习题 1.1 · 1Exercise 1.1 · 1教材 p.7 / PDF p.16Textbook p.7 / PDF p.16

复数四则运算Arithmetic with complex numbers

计算实部与虚部：(1) (4+i)/(2−5i)；(2) (1+2i)/(3−4i)+(2+3i)/(5i)；(3) 5/[(1−i)(2−i)(3−i)]；(4) (1−i)4。

Find the real and imaginary parts: (1) (4+i)/(2−5i); (2) (1+2i)/(3−4i)+(2+3i)/(5i); (3) 5/[(1−i)(2−i)(3−i)]; (4) (1−i)4.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

把每个结果写成“实数 + 实数乘 i”。

Write each answer as a real number plus a real multiple of i.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

分母里有 i，先乘共轭。共轭就是把 i 前的符号反过来，它能让分母变成实数。

An i in the denominator suggests multiplying by its conjugate: reverse the sign before i to make the denominator real.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 先记住 i2=−1。第(1)问分母有 2−5i，上下同乘 2+5i：这样分母变实数，分式值不变。

    Remember i2=−1. In part (1), multiply numerator and denominator by 2+5i. This makes the denominator real without changing the fraction.

  2. 把第(1)问分子逐项乘开，得到 3+22i；分母是 29。所以实部是 3/29，虚部是 22/29，虚部不是 22i/29。

    Expand the numerator in part (1) to get 3+22i; the denominator is 29. The real part is 3/29 and the imaginary part is 22/29, without the factor i.

  3. 第(2)问先分别算两项：第一项上下乘 3+4i，第二项用 1/i=−i。得到 (−1+2i)/5 与 (3−2i)/5，相加时虚部抵消。

    In part (2), handle the fractions separately: multiply the first by the conjugate 3+4i and use 1/i=−i in the second. This gives (−1+2i)/5 and (3−2i)/5; their imaginary parts cancel.

  4. 第(3)问先乘前两个因子，(1−i)(2−i)=1−3i；再乘 3−i，得到 −10i。最后 5/(−10i)=i/2。

    For part (3), multiply the first factors: (1−i)(2−i)=1−3i. Multiplication by 3−i gives −10i. Finally, 5/(−10i)=i/2.

  5. 第(4)问分两次平方：(1−i)2=−2i，再算 (−2i)2=−4。结果没有 i 项，所以虚部为零。

    For part (4), square twice: (1−i)2=−2i, then (−2i)2=−4. The result has no i term, so its imaginary part is zero.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

(2−5i)(2+5i) 等于多少？

What is (2−5i)(2+5i)?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

29。

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

分母乘共轭；多个线性因子先相乘。

Multiply a denominator by its conjugate. If it has several linear factors, multiply those factors first.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

分母乘共轭；多个线性因子先相乘。

Multiply a denominator by its conjugate. If it has several linear factors, multiply those factors first.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 分子分母乘 2+5i，得到 (8+20i+2i−5)/29=(3+22i)/29。

(1) Multiply numerator and denominator by 2+5i to obtain (8+20i+2i−5)/29=(3+22i)/29.

(2) 第一项为 (−5+10i)/25=−1/5+2i/5；第二项为 (3−2i)/5，相加得 2/5。

(2) The first term is (−5+10i)/25=−1/5+2i/5 and the second is (3−2i)/5. Their sum is 2/5.

(3) (1−i)(2−i)=1−3i，再乘 (3−i) 得 −10i，故结果为 i/2。

(3) First (1−i)(2−i)=1−3i. Multiplying by (3−i) gives −10i, so the result is i/2.

(4) (1−i)2=−2i，再平方为 −4。

(4) First (1−i)2=−2i. Squaring again gives −4.

最终答案

Final answer

依次为 (3+22i)/29、2/5、i/2、−4。

In order: (3+22i)/29, 2/5, i/2, −4.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

分母实数化 → 合并实虚部 → 用模长粗验。

Make the denominator real → collect real and imaginary parts → check the size using moduli.

易错点

Common mistakes

i2=−1；1/i=−i。

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.1 · 2Exercise 1.1 · 2教材 p.8 / PDF p.17Textbook p.8 / PDF p.17

模与辐角Modulus and argument

求模与辐角：(1) (1+i)/(2−23i)；(2) (1−i)3；(3) (1/5+2i/5)(3−i)；(4) (3−i)4。

Find the modulus and argument: (1) (1+i)/(2−23i); (2) (1−i)3; (3) (1/5+2i/5)(3−i); (4) (3−i)4.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

找出复数离原点多远，以及它指向哪个角度。

Find each complex number's distance from the origin and direction angle.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

题目是乘、除、乘方。用极形式更省事：长度相乘，角度相加。

These are products, quotients, and powers. Polar form makes them simpler: multiply lengths and add angles.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 模是“长度”，乘除时分别乘除；辐角是“方向”，乘除时分别相加相减。第(1)问的分子是 (2,π/4)，分母是 (4,−π/3)。

    Modulus means length: multiply or divide lengths. Argument means direction: add or subtract angles. In part (1), the numerator has (2,π/4) and the denominator has (4,−π/3).

  2. 第(1)问算长度 2/4、方向 π/4−(−π/3)=7π/12。减去负角会变成加，别漏掉括号。

    Part (1) gives length 2/4 and angle π/4−(−π/3)=7π/12. Keep the parentheses when subtracting a negative angle.

  3. 第(2)问 1−i 的长度是 2、方向是 −π/4。三次方就把长度三次方、角度乘3，得到 22 与 −3π/4。

    In part (2), 1−i has length 2 and angle −π/4. Cube the length and triple the angle: 22 and −3π/4.

  4. 第(3)问先直接乘开得 1+i，于是长度 2、方向 π/4。第(4)问把 3−i 写成 2e−iπ/6，四次方给长度 16、方向 −2π/3。

    In part (3), expansion gives 1+i, with length 2 and angle π/4. In part (4), write 3−i=2e−iπ/6; its fourth power has length 16 and angle −2π/3.

  5. 检查角度象限。主辐角只选 (−π,π] 中一个；若题目要所有辐角，每个主辐角再加 2kπ，其中 k 为整数。

    Check the quadrant. A principal argument is the one chosen in (−π,π]. For all arguments, add 2kπ with integer k.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

复数相除时，两个辐角是相加还是相减？

When dividing complex numbers, do you add or subtract their arguments?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

分子的辐角减去分母的辐角。

Subtract the denominator argument from the numerator argument.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

乘除时模相乘相除、辐角相加相减；辐角写成主值加 2kπ。

Multiply or divide moduli, and add or subtract arguments. Write every argument as its principal value plus 2kπ.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

乘除时模相乘相除、辐角相加相减；辐角写成主值加 2kπ。

Multiply or divide moduli, and add or subtract arguments. Write every argument as its principal value plus 2kπ.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 分子模 2、角 π/4；分母模 4、角 −π/3。所以模 2/4，角 7π/12+2kπ。

(1) The numerator has modulus 2 and argument π/4. The denominator has modulus 4 and argument −π/3. Thus the quotient has modulus 2/4 and argument 7π/12+2kπ.

(2) 模 (2)3=22，角 −3π/4+2kπ。

(2) The modulus is (2)3=22 and the argument is −3π/4+2kπ.

(3) 乘开得 1+i，模 2，角 π/4+2kπ。

(3) Multiplication gives 1+i, with modulus 2 and argument π/4+2kπ.

(4) 3−i=2e−iπ/6，四次方为 16e−2πi/3，模 16，角 −2π/3+2kπ。

(4) Write 3−i=2e−iπ/6. Its fourth power is 16e−2πi/3, with modulus 16 and argument −2π/3+2kπ.

最终答案

Final answer

模依次为 2/4,22,2,16；主辐角依次 7π/12,−3π/4,π/4,−2π/3。

The moduli are 2/4,22,2,16; the principal arguments are 7π/12,−3π/4,π/4,−2π/3.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

先分别求模、角，再合成，最后归入指定主值区间。

Find each modulus and angle → combine them → move the final angle into the requested principal range.

易错点

Common mistakes

反正切的数值不足以确定象限。

An arctangent value alone does not identify the quadrant.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.1 · 3Exercise 1.1 · 3教材 p.8 / PDF p.17Textbook p.8 / PDF p.17

复平面轨迹Loci in the complex plane

描述轨迹：(1) |z−3i|+|z+3i|=9；(2) |z−2+i|≤3；(3) 0<\arg[(z−i)/(z+i)]<π/4（取主辐角）。

Describe each locus: (1) |z−3i|+|z+3i|=9; (2) |z−2+i|≤3; (3) 0<\arg[(z−i)/(z+i)]<π/4, using the principal argument.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

把复数条件翻译成平面上的图形或区域。

Turn complex-number conditions into plane curves or regions.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

模就是距离；两个固定点的距离和固定，说明是椭圆。含辐角的条件可以变成实部、虚部的大小关系。

Modulus means distance. A fixed sum of distances to two points gives an ellipse. An argument restriction can be translated into real/imaginary inequalities.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第一问把 3i、−3i 标成焦点，距离和 9 给出长半轴 9/2。

    In part (1), mark 3i and −3i as foci. A distance sum of 9 gives semimajor axis 9/2.

  2. 第二问先写成 |z−(2−i)|≤3，直接读出圆心和半径。

    In part (2), write |z−(2−i)|≤3 and read off the center and radius.

  3. 第三问设 z=x+iy，把比值分母实数化；角在第一象限且小于 π/4，就是 0<ℑw<ℜw。

    In part (3), set z=x+iy and make the quotient denominator real. An angle between zero and π/4 means 0<ℑw<ℜw.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

|z−(2−i)|≤3 的圆心是什么？

What is the center of |z−(2−i)|≤3?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

(2,−1)。

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

距离和对应椭圆；距离不等式对应圆盘；辐角不等式可先写出比值的实虚部。

A fixed sum of distances gives an ellipse. A distance inequality gives a disk. For an argument inequality, first find the quotient's real and imaginary parts.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

距离和对应椭圆；距离不等式对应圆盘；辐角不等式可先写出比值的实虚部。

A fixed sum of distances gives an ellipse. A distance inequality gives a disk. For an argument inequality, first find the quotient's real and imaginary parts.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 焦点 (0,±3)，长半轴 a=9/2，焦距参数 c=3，故短半轴平方 b2=a2−c2=45/4。轨迹为 x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1。

(1) The foci are (0,±3). The semimajor axis is a=9/2 and the focal parameter is c=3, so the squared semiminor axis is b2=a2−c2=45/4. The locus is x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1.

(2) |z−(2−i)|≤3，是圆心 (2,−1)、半径 3 的闭圆盘。

(2) Rewrite it as |z−(2−i)|≤3. This is the closed disk with center (2,−1) and radius 3.

(3) 写 z=x+iy，分母实数化：w=(z−i)/(z+i)=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2]。角在 (0,π/4) 等价于 0<Imw<Rew，所以 x<0 且 x2+y2−1>−2x，即 (x+1)2+y2>2。这些严格不等式自动排除 z=±i。

(3) Put z=x+iy and make the denominator real: w=(z−i)/(z+i)=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2]. An angle in (0,π/4) is equivalent to 0<Imw<Rew. Thus x<0 and x2+y2−1>−2x, or (x+1)2+y2>2. These strict inequalities automatically exclude z=±i.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) 竖直长轴椭圆；(2) 闭圆盘；(3) x<0 且 (x+1)2+y2>2 的开区域。

(1) An ellipse with vertical major axis. (2) A closed disk. (3) The open region satisfying x<0 and (x+1)2+y2>2.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

把模解释成距离，把辐角解释成转角；复杂映射可转成实虚部不等式。

Read modulus as distance and argument as angle. For a complicated mapping, turn the condition into inequalities for real and imaginary parts.

易错点

Common mistakes

严格边界不能包含；比值为零或无定义时辐角无意义。

A strict inequality excludes its boundary. The argument is undefined when the quotient is zero or undefined.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.1 · 4Exercise 1.1 · 4教材 p.8 / PDF p.17Textbook p.8 / PDF p.17

复幂与三角和Complex powers and trigonometric sums

计算：(1) ii；(2) sinϕ+sin2ϕ+⋯+sinnϕ。

Calculate: (1) ii; (2) sinϕ+sin2ϕ+⋯+sinnϕ.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

求出复幂的全部值，并把很多正弦的和压成一个公式。

Find all values of a complex power and compress a sine sum into one formula.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

复指数必须先定义对数；连续角度的正弦和，可以借用等比数列求和。

A complex power first needs a logarithm. Sines at successive angles can be collected using a geometric series.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第一问不要直接套实数幂规则。先写 ii=eilogi。

    For part (1), do not apply real-power rules directly. Write ii=eilogi.

  2. 把 logi=i(π/2+2kπ) 代进去，保留所有整数 k。

    Insert logi=i(π/2+2kπ) and retain every integer k.

  3. 第二问先求 ∑j=1neijϕ 的等比和，最后取虚部；ϕ=2kπ 单独代原式。

    For part (2), sum ∑j=1neijϕ geometrically, then take its imaginary part. Substitute into the original sum separately when ϕ=2kπ.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

logi 为什么含 2kπ？

Why does logi contain 2kπ?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

因为转过任意整圈都表示同一个复数，但对数会记录这个角度。

Every full turn represents the same complex number, while the logarithm records the additional angle.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

复幂通过多值对数定义；三角和取复指数等比和的虚部。

Define a complex power through the multivalued logarithm. For the sine sum, take the imaginary part of a geometric sum of complex exponentials.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

复幂通过多值对数定义；三角和取复指数等比和的虚部。

Define a complex power through the multivalued logarithm. For the sine sum, take the imaginary part of a geometric sum of complex exponentials.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) logi=i(π/2+2kπ)，因此 ii=eilogi=e−π/2−2kπ，k∈Z。若指定主值，则为 e−π/2。

(1) Since logi=i(π/2+2kπ), we have ii=eilogi=e−π/2−2kπ, k∈Z. If the principal value is requested, it is e−π/2.

(2) 当 eiϕ≠1，∑j=1neijϕ=ei(n+1)ϕ/2sin(nϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2)。取虚部得 sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2)。当 ϕ=2kπ，原和直接为零。

(2) When eiϕ≠1, the geometric sum is ∑j=1neijϕ=ei(n+1)ϕ/2sin(nϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2). Its imaginary part is sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2). When ϕ=2kπ, the original sum is directly zero.

最终答案

Final answer

ii 的全部值为 e−π/2−2kπ；三角和为 sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)sin(ϕ/2)（分母零时取原和 0）。

All values of ii are e−π/2−2kπ. The trigonometric sum is sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)sin(ϕ/2); when the denominator is zero, use the original sum, 0.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

先写指数形式，再用多值对数或等比和。

Write exponential form first. Then use either the multivalued logarithm or the geometric-sum formula.

易错点

Common mistakes

不能把多值复幂只写成主值而不说明。

Do not give only the principal value of a multivalued power without stating the branch choice.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.1 · 5Exercise 1.1 · 5教材 p.8 / PDF p.17Textbook p.8 / PDF p.17

三次单位根Cube roots of unity

求 z2+z+1=0。

Solve z2+z+1=0.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

找出这个二次方程的两个复数根。

Find the two complex roots of this quadratic.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

三个连续幂相加，让人想到 z3−1=(z−1)(z2+z+1)。

Three consecutive powers suggest z3−1=(z−1)(z2+z+1).

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 把原式乘 z−1，变成 z3=1。

    Multiply by z−1 to obtain z3=1.

  2. 在单位圆上列出三个等间隔根：角度是 0,2π/3,4π/3。

    List the three equally spaced unit-circle roots at angles 0,2π/3,4π/3.

  3. 检查原方程：z=1 不符合，所以删掉它，留下另外两个根。

    Check the original equation. The root z=1 fails, so remove it and retain the other two.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

z=1 是原方程的根吗？

Is z=1 a root of the original equation?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不是。代入得到 3，不等于零。

No. It gives 3, not zero.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

乘 z−1 转成 z3=1，同时排除 z=1。

Multiply by z−1 to obtain z3=1, then exclude z=1.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

乘 z−1 转成 z3=1，同时排除 z=1。

Multiply by z−1 to obtain z3=1, then exclude z=1.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(z−1)(z2+z+1)=z3−1。三个单位根为 1,e2πi/3,e4πi/3，其中 1 不满足原方程。故 z=(−1±i3)/2。也可用求根公式直接核验。

Use (z−1)(z2+z+1)=z3−1. The three cube roots of unity are 1,e2πi/3,e4πi/3. Of these, 1 does not satisfy the original equation. Hence z=(−1±i3)/2. The quadratic formula also verifies the result.

最终答案

Final answer

z=(−1±i3)/2。

定义域排除条件Finding the domain

求定义域：(1) f=1/(z2+9)；(2) f=z/[(z+z*)(4−|z|2)]。

Find the domain: (1) f=1/(z2+9); (2) f=z/[(z+z*)(4−|z|2)].

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

找出哪些复数能代入原式，哪些必须排除。

Identify the complex numbers that can be substituted into each expression.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

分母不能为零。含共轭和模时，先改写成两个实变量。

A denominator cannot be zero. Rewrite conjugates and moduli using two real variables.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第一问分解 z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i)。

    Factor z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i) in part (1).

  2. 第二问设 z=x+iy，写出 z+z*=2x 和 |z|2=x2+y2。

    In part (2), set z=x+iy and use z+z*=2x and |z|2=x2+y2.

  3. 分别排除每个分母因子的零点：第一问是两个点，第二问是一条轴和一个圆周。

    Exclude the zero set of each denominator factor: two points in part (1), and an axis plus a circle in part (2).

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

第二问的 x=0 能保留吗？

Can points with x=0 remain in the second domain?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不能。此时分母因子 z+z* 为零。

No. The denominator factor z+z* is zero there.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

所有分母因子都要非零；共轭与模写成 x,y。

Every denominator factor must be nonzero. Write conjugates and moduli in terms of x,y.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

所有分母因子都要非零；共轭与模写成 x,y。

Every denominator factor must be nonzero. Write conjugates and moduli in terms of x,y.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i)，所以排除 z=±3i。

(1) Since z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i), exclude z=±3i.

(2) z+z*=2x，|z|2=x2+y2。排除虚轴 x=0 和圆周 x2+y2=4，其余点均有定义。

(2) We have z+z*=2x and |z|2=x2+y2. Exclude the imaginary axis x=0 and the circle x2+y2=4. The function is defined at every other point.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) C⧵{3i,−3i}；(2) {x+iy:x≠0, x2+y2≠4}。

Common mistakes

分子同时为零也不能自动补入原定义域。

A simultaneous zero of the numerator does not automatically restore a point to the original domain.

分离实部虚部Separating real and imaginary parts

写成 u+iv：(1) z3+2zz*−2；(2) 3eiz。

Write each expression as u+iv: (1) z3+2zz*−2; (2) 3eiz.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

把复数函数拆成看得见的实部 u 和虚部 v。

Separate the function into its real part u and imaginary part v.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

题目要求 u+iv，就代入 z=x+iy，把所有 i 集中起来。

A request for u+iv suggests substituting z=x+iy and collecting i terms.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第一问先展开 (x+iy)3，同时把 zz* 直接换成 x2+y2。

    In part (1), expand (x+iy)3 and replace zz* directly by x2+y2.

  2. 把不含 i 的项收成 u，i 的系数收成 v。

    Collect terms without i into u, and coefficients of i into v.

  3. 第二问先算 iz=ix−y，再写 eix=cosx+isinx。

    In part (2), first compute iz=ix−y, then use eix=cosx+isinx.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

iz 的实部是 x 还是 −y？

Is the real part of iz x or −y?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

是 −y。

It is −y.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

代入 z=x+iy；注意 zz*=x2+y2 和 iz=ix−y。

Substitute z=x+iy. Use zz*=x2+y2 and iz=ix−y.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

代入 z=x+iy；注意 zz*=x2+y2 和 iz=ix−y。

Substitute z=x+iy. Use zz*=x2+y2 and iz=ix−y.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) z3=x3−3xy2+i(3x2y−y3)，而 2zz*=2x2+2y2 为实数。故 u=x3−3xy2+2x2+2y2−2，v=3x2y−y3。

(1) Expand z3=x3−3xy2+i(3x2y−y3). The term 2zz*=2x2+2y2 is real. Therefore u=x3−3xy2+2x2+2y2−2 and v=3x2y−y3.

(2) 3eiz=3e−y(cosx+isinx)，故 u=3e−ycosx，v=3e−ysinx。

(2) Rewrite 3eiz=3e−y(cosx+isinx). Thus u=3e−ycosx and v=3e−ysinx.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) u=x3−3xy2+2x2+2y2−2,v=3x2y−y3；(2) u=3e−ycosx,v=3e−ysinx。

先消共轭与指数，再按实虚部收集。

Remove conjugates and rewrite exponentials first → collect the real and imaginary terms.

易错点

Common mistakes

eiz 的衰减因子是 e−y。

The decay factor in eiz is e−y.

习题 1.2 · 3Exercise 1.2 · 3教材 p.13 / PDF p.22Textbook p.13 / PDF p.22

四个支点与两叶黎曼面Four branch points and a two-sheeted Riemann surface

确定 f(z)=3z(z2+9) 的支点并构造相应黎曼面。

Find the branch points of f(z)=3z(z2+9) and construct its Riemann surface.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

找出绕一圈会让平方根变号的点，并说明怎样拼出单值曲面。

Find where a circuit changes the square-root sign, then describe a single-valued surface.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

平方根内有三个一次零点。绕一次零点会变号，所以还要检查无穷远。

There are three simple zeros under the square root. A circuit around each reverses the sign, so infinity must also be checked.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 先分解为 3z(z−3i)(z+3i)，标出三个有限支点。

    Factor the expression as 3z(z−3i)(z+3i) and mark its three finite branch points.

  2. 令 w=1/z。观察 w=0 绕圈时出现的半整数幂，确认无穷远也是支点。

    Set w=1/z. The half-integer power near w=0 shows that infinity is also a branch point.

  3. 把四个支点成对用不交叉割线连接；取两张割面，把每条割线两边交叉粘到另一张。

    Join paired branch points with disjoint cuts. Take two cut copies and join opposite banks to the other copy.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

绕一个一次零点一圈，平方根的符号会怎样？

What happens to a square root after one circuit around a simple zero?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

翻转。再绕一圈才恢复。

Its sign reverses; a second circuit restores it.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

三个简单零点和无穷远都检查；两张割面交叉粘合。

Check all three simple zeros and infinity. Join two cut surfaces crosswise.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

三个简单零点和无穷远都检查；两张割面交叉粘合。

Check all three simple zeros and infinity. Join two cut surfaces crosswise.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

3z(z2+9)=3z(z−3i)(z+3i)，三个有限零点均一阶，绕任一个一周平方根翻号，故 0,±3i 是支点。令 w=1/z，f=3w−3/21+9w2，绕 w=0 一周也翻号，因此无穷远也是支点。

Factor 3z(z2+9)=3z(z−3i)(z+3i). All three finite zeros have order one. A circuit around any one of them reverses the square-root sign, so 0,±3i are branch points. Set w=1/z to obtain f=3w−3/21+9w2. A circuit around w=0 also reverses the sign, so infinity is another branch point.

可在复球面取两条不相交割线：连接 −3i 与 0 的线段，以及从 3i 沿正虚轴延伸至无穷远的射线。制作两张同样割开的球面，各条割线的上岸与另一张的下岸交叉粘合。越过割线换叶，绕两个支点符号恢复；得到双叶、四分支点的黎曼面（属为 1）。

On the complex sphere, choose two disjoint cuts: the segment joining −3i to 0, and the ray from 3i along the positive imaginary axis to infinity. Make two equally cut copies of the sphere. For each cut, join the upper bank of one copy to the lower bank of the other. Crossing a cut changes sheets; a circuit enclosing two branch points restores the sign. The result has two sheets and four branch points, with genus 1.

最终答案

Final answer

支点为 −3i,0,3i,∞；两张割面交叉粘合。

The branch points are −3i,0,3i,∞. Join two cut surfaces crosswise.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

有限奇数阶零极点 + 无穷远变换 → 配对割线 → 双叶交叉粘合。

Check finite zeros and poles of odd order, plus infinity → pair the cuts → join the two sheets crosswise.

易错点

Common mistakes

三次多项式开平方的无穷远不能遗漏。

For the square root of a cubic polynomial, do not overlook infinity.

微分与解析函数Differentiation and analytic functions

6 道主编号题6 numbered exercises
习题 1.3 · 1Exercise 1.3 · 1教材 p.20 / PDF p.29Textbook p.20 / PDF p.29

逐点可导与区域解析Differentiability at points versus analyticity on a region

判断可导与解析位置：(1) z+3z*；(2) x2−y2−2y+i(2x−2xy)；(3) z+1/z；(4) cosxcoshy−isinxsinhy。

Find where each function is differentiable and analytic: (1) z+3z*; (2) x2−y2−2y+i(2x−2xy); (3) z+1/z; (4) cosxcoshy−isinxsinhy.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

分别回答“哪些点有复导数”和“哪些区域内解析”。

Answer separately where the complex derivative exists and where the function is analytic.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

含共轭或 x、y 的式子不能直接按 z 求导。先检查两条 C–R 方程。

Conjugates or explicit x,y terms prevent direct differentiation as a function of z. Start with both C–R equations.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 先拆成 f=u+iv。两条 C–R 条件 ux=vy、uy=−vx 必须同时成立；它们先帮你筛选“可能可导”的点。

    Write f=u+iv. Both Cauchy–Riemann equations, ux=vy and uy=−vx, must hold. They first identify possible points of differentiability.

  2. 第(1)问化成 4x−2iy，于是 ux=4,vy=−2，第一条就不成立，处处不可导。

    Part (1) becomes 4x−2iy, so ux=4,vy=−2. The first equation fails everywhere: there are no differentiable points.

  3. 第(2)问第一条给 2x=−2x，所以 x=0；第二条给 −2y−2=−2+2y，所以 y=0。偏导连续，原点可导，导数为 2i。

    In part (2), the first equation gives 2x=−2x, hence x=0. The second gives −2y−2=−2+2y, hence y=0. Continuous partial derivatives establish differentiability there, with derivative 2i.

  4. 别在第(2)问停在“原点可导”。解析要求一个小圆盘内处处可导，而这里只有一个点，所以无处解析。

    Do not stop at “differentiable at the origin” in part (2). Analyticity requires differentiability throughout a small open disk. A single point is not enough, so the function is nowhere analytic.

  5. 第(3)问 z+1/z 只需排除没有定义的原点，其他地方解析。第(4)问是 cosz，整个复平面解析。

    For part (3), z+1/z is analytic wherever it is defined: exclude the origin. Part (4) is cosz, analytic on the whole plane.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

只在原点可导，能叫作在原点解析吗？

If a function is differentiable only at the origin, is it analytic there?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不能。解析要求原点周围一个开邻域内处处可导。

No. Analyticity requires differentiability throughout an open neighborhood.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

对非标准解析表达式列两条 C–R 条件，先解点集，再判断是否含开邻域。

For an expression not already known to be analytic, write both C–R equations. Solve for the points where they hold, then ask whether that set contains an open neighborhood.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

对非标准解析表达式列两条 C–R 条件，先解点集，再判断是否含开邻域。

For an expression not already known to be analytic, write both C–R equations. Solve for the points where they hold, then ask whether that set contains an open neighborhood.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) u=4x,v=−2y，ux=4≠vy=−2，处处不可导，处处不解析。

(1) Here u=4x,v=−2y and ux=4≠vy=−2. The function is nowhere complex differentiable and nowhere analytic.

(2) ux=2x,vy=−2x，故 x=0；uy=−2y−2,−vx=−2+2y，故 y=0。偏导连续，因此只在原点可导，f′(0)=ux+ivx=2i；任何开邻域都含不可导点，所以无处解析。

(2) We have ux=2x,vy=−2x, so x=0; also uy=−2y−2,−vx=−2+2y, so y=0. The partial derivatives are continuous, so differentiability holds only at the origin, with f′(0)=ux+ivx=2i. Every open neighborhood contains nondifferentiable points, so the function is nowhere analytic.

(3) 在 z≠0 是解析函数之和，导数 1−1/z2；原点无定义。

(3) On z≠0, it is a sum of analytic functions, with derivative 1−1/z2. It is undefined at the origin.

(4) 等于 cosz，整函数，导数 −sinz。

(4) This equals cosz. It is entire, with derivative −sinz.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) 无处可导；(2) 仅原点可导、无处解析；(3) z≠0 可导且解析；(4) 全平面解析。

(1) Nowhere differentiable. (2) Differentiable only at the origin, nowhere analytic. (3) Differentiable and analytic for z≠0. (4) Analytic on the whole plane.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

求 C–R 点集 → 利用偏导连续判断可导 → 看是否有开邻域。

Solve C–R → use continuity of partial derivatives to establish differentiability → check for an open neighborhood.

易错点

Common mistakes

一个点可导不等于在该点解析。

Being differentiable at one point does not mean being analytic there.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.3 · 2Exercise 1.3 · 2教材 p.20 / PDF p.29Textbook p.20 / PDF p.29

解析函数判定：某点可导还不够Analyticity: one differentiable point is not enough

判断下列条件能否给出解析函数：(1) f=z2+2zz*−2；(2) Ref=x2+y2。

Determine whether these conditions define an analytic function: (1) f=z2+2zz*−2; (2) Ref=x2+y2.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

判断是否存在一块开区域，让函数在里面每一点都可导。

Decide whether there is an open region on which the function is differentiable at every point.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

题目问解析性。只找到一个可导点不够：一个点周围还要有整片可导的邻域。

The question is about analyticity. One differentiable point is not enough; an entire neighborhood must also consist of differentiable points.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第(1)问先写 u=3x2+y2−2,v=2xy，计算四个一阶偏导。

    For part (1), write u=3x2+y2−2,v=2xy and compute the four first partial derivatives.

  2. C–R 两条式子给 6x=2x、2y=−2y，所以只有原点可导。单点不是开区域，因此无处解析。

    The Cauchy–Riemann equations give 6x=2x and 2y=−2y. Only the origin is differentiable. A single point is not open, so the function is nowhere analytic.

  3. 第(2)问没有给虚部，先检查实部是否调和。算 uxx+uyy=4，不是0，所以不用继续找虚部：所求解析函数不存在。

    Part (2) supplies no imaginary part. First test harmonicity of the real part: uxx+uyy=4, not zero. Stop there: the requested analytic function does not exist.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

x2+y2 的拉普拉斯 uxx+uyy 等于多少？

What is uxx+uyy for u=x2+y2?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

4。

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

整函数全平面解析；其实部必须调和。

An entire function is analytic on the whole plane. Its real part must be harmonic.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

先分清问题：可导是在某一个点讨论；解析要求在一个开区域内的每一点都可导；整函数进一步要求整个复平面都解析。本题按教材判断解析性，不能只检查有没有一个可导点。

Differentiability is tested at a point. Analyticity requires differentiability at every point of an open region. An entire function is analytic on the whole complex plane. Follow the textbook’s question about analyticity rather than merely finding one differentiable point.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 写 z=x+iy，得到 u=3x2+y2−2,v=2xy。求偏导后，C–R 条件是 6x=2x 和 2y=−2y，所以只能有 x=y=0。偏导连续，原点确实可导；但原点旁边任意小的圆盘都含不可导点，因此不存在解析的开区域，函数无处解析。它当然也不是整函数。

(1) Write z=x+iy. Then u=3x2+y2−2,v=2xy. The Cauchy–Riemann equations are 6x=2x and 2y=−2y, so x=y=0 is the only candidate. The partial derivatives are continuous, so the function is differentiable at the origin. But every small disk around it contains nondifferentiable points. There is no open region of analyticity: the function is nowhere analytic. Consequently it is not entire either.

(2) 解析函数的实部必须调和。对题给的 u=x2+y2 求二阶偏导：uxx+uyy=2+2=4，不是零。因此不可能在任何非空开区域内找到以它为实部的解析函数。这里的结论比“不是整函数”更强。

(2) The real part of an analytic function must be harmonic. For u=x2+y2, the second derivatives give uxx+uyy=2+2=4, rather than zero. No analytic function on any nonempty open region can have this real part. This is stronger than merely saying that it is not entire.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) 只在原点可导，无处解析；(2) 满足题给实部的解析函数不存在。

(1) Differentiable only at the origin and nowhere analytic. (2) No analytic function has the prescribed real part.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

实部已知时先验调和，可立即否定。

When the real part is given, test harmonicity first. It can rule out the function immediately.

易错点

Common mistakes

“不是整函数”只排除了全平面解析，不能自动推出无处解析。例如 1/z 在去掉原点后解析，却不是整函数。本题要明确说明是否存在解析的开区域。

“Not entire” rules out analyticity on the whole plane, but does not imply nowhere analytic. For example, 1/z is analytic away from the origin and is not entire. State whether an open region of analyticity exists.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.3 · 3Exercise 1.3 · 3教材 p.20 / PDF p.29Textbook p.20 / PDF p.29

由实部或虚部重建解析函数Reconstructing an analytic function from one part

求解析函数：(1) u=x2−y2,f(0)=0；(2) v=exsiny,f(0)=0；(3) u=x/(x2+y2),f(2)=1/2；(4) v=x2−y2+xy,f(i)=1−i。

Find the analytic function: (1) u=x2−y2,f(0)=0; (2) v=exsiny,f(0)=0; (3) u=x/(x2+y2),f(2)=1/2; (4) v=x2−y2+xy,f(i)=1−i.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

已知实部或虚部，补出另一半，再用给定函数值定常数。

Recover the missing real or imaginary part, then fix the constant using the given function value.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

解析函数的两半由 C–R 联系。积分一次后，别把剩下的未知函数误当成常数。

C–R links the two parts of an analytic function. After one integration, the leftover may still depend on the other variable.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 只对 y 积分时，“积分常数”可以是 x 的函数；只对 x 积分时也一样。这就是下面为什么先写 g(x) 或 g(y)，再用另一条 C–R 来确定它。

    When integrating with respect to y, the integration constant may depend on x, and vice versa. Write g(x) or g(y) first, then use the other Cauchy–Riemann equation to determine it.

  2. 第(1)问从 vy=2x 得 v=2xy+g(x)；再用 vx=2y 得 g′=0。给定值把常数定为0，于是 f=z2。

    Part (1): integrate vy=2x to get v=2xy+g(x). Then vx=2y gives g′=0. The given value sets the constant to zero, giving f=z2.

  3. 第(2)问已知虚部，改从 ux=vy=excosy 积分，得 u=excosy+g(y)。另一条 C–R 让 g 为常数，f(0)=0 给 g=−1。

    Part (2) gives the imaginary part. Integrate ux=vy=excosy to get u=excosy+g(y). The other equation makes g constant; f(0)=0 gives g=−1.

  4. 第(3)问先分母实数化 1/z=(x−iy)/(x2+y2)，认出题给实部。另一半只能差一个纯虚常数，代 f(2)=1/2 将它定为0。

    For part (3), rationalize 1/z=(x−iy)/(x2+y2) to recognize the real part. The analytic function can differ only by an imaginary constant. Use f(2)=1/2 to set it to zero.

  5. 第(4)问积分 ux=vy=x−2y，得 u=x2/2−2xy+g(y)；再用 uy=−vx 得 g=−y2/2+C。代 z=i 得 C=3/2。

    Part (4): integrate ux=vy=x−2y to get u=x2/2−2xy+g(y). Then uy=−vx gives g=−y2/2+C. Substituting z=i gives C=3/2.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

对 y 积分时，为什么写 g(x)？

Why write g(x) after integrating with respect to y?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

因为任何只依赖 x 的函数对 y 的导数都为零。

Every function depending only on x has zero derivative with respect to y.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

用 C–R 积分求共轭，再用初值确定剩余实常数或虚常数。

Integrate the C–R equations to find the missing conjugate part. Then use the initial value to fix the remaining real or imaginary constant.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

用 C–R 积分求共轭，再用初值确定剩余实常数或虚常数。

Integrate the C–R equations to find the missing conjugate part. Then use the initial value to fix the remaining real or imaginary constant.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) vy=2x，故 v=2xy+g(x)；vx=2y 得 g 为常数。初值给 g=0，所以 f=z2。

(1) From vy=2x we obtain v=2xy+g(x). Then vx=2y says that g is constant. The initial value gives g=0, hence f=z2.

(2) ux=vy=excosy，积分得 u=excosy+g(y)；uy=−vx 得 g′=0。由 f(0)=0 得 g=−1，所以 f=ez−1。

(2) Integrating ux=vy=excosy gives u=excosy+g(y). Then uy=−vx gives g′=0. From f(0)=0 we find g=−1, so f=ez−1.

(3) 识别 Re(1/z)=x/(x2+y2)，故 f=1/z+iC（每个连通区域常数固定）。f(2)=1/2 给 C=0。

(3) Recognize Re(1/z)=x/(x2+y2). Therefore f=1/z+iC, with a fixed constant on each connected region. The condition f(2)=1/2 gives C=0.

(4) ux=vy=x−2y，故 u=x2/2−2xy+g(y)；uy=−vx=−2x−y，故 g=−y2/2+C。于是 f=(1/2+i)z2+C，代 z=i 得 C=3/2。

(4) From ux=vy=x−2y we obtain u=x2/2−2xy+g(y). Then uy=−vx=−2x−y gives g=−y2/2+C. Thus f=(1/2+i)z2+C. Substituting z=i gives C=3/2.

最终答案

Final answer

z2；ez−1；1/z（z≠0）；(1/2+i)z2+3/2。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

验调和 → 积分一条 C–R → 另一条补函数 → 初值定常数。

Check harmonicity → integrate one C–R equation → use the other to determine the leftover function → apply the initial value.

易错点

Common mistakes

积分后的“常数”起初是另一变量的函数。

The integration “constant” may initially be a function of the other variable.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.3 · 4Exercise 1.3 · 4教材 p.20 / PDF p.29Textbook p.20 / PDF p.29

极坐标 C–R 条件C–R equations in polar coordinates

证明 uρ=ρ−1vϕ，vρ=−ρ−1uϕ。

Prove uρ=ρ−1vϕ and vρ=−ρ−1uϕ.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

把直角坐标的 C–R 方程改写成半径、角度的形式。

Rewrite Cartesian C–R in terms of radius and angle.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

坐标变了，导数要用链式法则连接起来。

A coordinate change requires the chain rule to connect the derivatives.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 先写 x=ρcosϕ,y=ρsinϕ，算 xρ,yρ,xϕ,yϕ。

    Write x=ρcosϕ,y=ρsinϕ and find xρ,yρ,xϕ,yϕ.

  2. 例如 uρ=uxcosϕ+uysinϕ，把另外三个导数也展开。

    For example, uρ=uxcosϕ+uysinϕ. Expand the other three derivatives as well.

  3. 用 ux=vy,uy=−vx 替换，比较两边；只在 ρ>0 除以半径。

    Substitute ux=vy,uy=−vx and compare the two sides. Divide by the radius only for ρ>0.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

xϕ 等于多少？

What is xϕ?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

−ρsinϕ。

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

用 x=ρcosϕ,y=ρsinϕ 的链式法则。

Apply the chain rule for x=ρcosϕ,y=ρsinϕ.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

用 x=ρcosϕ,y=ρsinϕ 的链式法则。

Apply the chain rule for x=ρcosϕ,y=ρsinϕ.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

uρ=uxcosϕ+uysinϕ，vϕ=−ρvxsinϕ+ρvycosϕ。代入 vx=−uy,vy=ux 得 vϕ=ρuρ。

The chain rule gives uρ=uxcosϕ+uysinϕ and vϕ=−ρvxsinϕ+ρvycosϕ. Substituting vx=−uy,vy=ux yields vϕ=ρuρ.

同理 vρ=vxcosϕ+vysinϕ=−uycosϕ+uxsinϕ，而 uϕ=−ρuxsinϕ+ρuycosϕ，故 vρ=−uϕ/ρ。

Likewise, vρ=vxcosϕ+vysinϕ=−uycosϕ+uxsinϕ, while uϕ=−ρuxsinϕ+ρuycosϕ. Hence vρ=−uϕ/ρ.

最终答案

Final answer

uρ=vϕ/ρ, vρ=−uϕ/ρ，适用于 ρ>0。

uρ=vϕ/ρ, vρ=−uϕ/ρ, valid for ρ>0.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

先完整写链式法则，再代直角坐标 C–R。

Write the full chain rule first → substitute Cartesian C–R.

易错点

Common mistakes

极坐标在原点奇异，不能直接除以零。

Polar coordinates are singular at the origin. Do not divide by zero there.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.3 · 5Exercise 1.3 · 5教材 p.20 / PDF p.29Textbook p.20 / PDF p.29

极坐标调和方程The harmonic equation in polar coordinates

证明解析函数的实虚部满足 ρ2uρρ+ρuρ+uϕϕ=0 及对应的 v 方程。

Prove that the real and imaginary parts of an analytic function satisfy ρ2uρρ+ρuρ+uϕϕ=0 and the corresponding equation for v.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

消掉虚部 v，留下只含实部 u 的二阶方程。

Eliminate v and obtain a second-order equation involving only u.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

上一题的极坐标 C–R 一边含 u、一边含 v。交叉求导能让 v 的混合导数互相抵消。

The polar C–R equations link u and v. Differentiating in opposite orders lets the mixed derivatives of v cancel.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 先把第一条写成 ρuρ=vϕ，对 ρ 求导。

    Write the first equation as ρuρ=vϕ and differentiate in ρ.

  2. 把另一条写成 ρvρ=−uϕ，对 ϕ 求导。

    Write the other as ρvρ=−uϕ and differentiate in ϕ.

  3. 利用 vϕρ=vρϕ 消去 v，再整理；交换 u、v 得另一条方程。

    Use vϕρ=vρϕ to eliminate v, then rearrange. Exchange u and v for the second equation.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

对 ρuρ 求 ρ 导数能漏掉 uρ 吗？

Can the derivative of ρuρ omit uρ?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不能。乘积法则给 uρ+ρuρρ。

No. The product rule gives uρ+ρuρρ.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

对极坐标 C–R 交叉求导，消去另一函数。

Differentiate the polar C–R equations in different directions to eliminate the other function.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

对极坐标 C–R 交叉求导，消去另一函数。

Differentiate the polar C–R equations in different directions to eliminate the other function.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

ρuρ=vϕ 对 ρ 求导得 uρ+ρuρρ=vϕρ。由 vρ=−uϕ/ρ 得 vρϕ=−uϕϕ/ρ。混合导数相等，乘 ρ 即得 ρuρ+ρ2uρρ+uϕϕ=0。

Differentiate ρuρ=vϕ with respect to ρ to obtain uρ+ρuρρ=vϕρ. From vρ=−uϕ/ρ we get vρϕ=−uϕϕ/ρ. Equate the mixed derivatives and multiply by ρ to obtain ρuρ+ρ2uρρ+uϕϕ=0.

交换 u,v 并利用另一条 C–R，完全同样得到 ρ2vρρ+ρvρ+vϕϕ=0。

Exchange u,v and use the other C–R equation. The same calculation gives ρ2vρρ+ρvρ+vϕϕ=0.

最终答案

Final answer

uρρ+uρ/ρ+uϕϕ/ρ2=0；v 同理。

uρρ+uρ/ρ+uϕϕ/ρ2=0; the same holds for v.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

C–R 乘半径 → 两次求导 → 混合导数抵消。

Multiply C–R by the radius → differentiate twice → cancel mixed derivatives.

易错点

Common mistakes

求导时 1/ρ 不是常数；结论在 ρ>0 使用。

When differentiating, 1/ρ is not constant. The result is used for ρ>0.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.3 · 6Exercise 1.3 · 6教材 p.20 / PDF p.29Textbook p.20 / PDF p.29条件 / 勘误Conditions / correction

等实部与等虚部曲线正交Orthogonality of real- and imaginary-part level curves

证明解析函数的曲线族 u(x,y)=c1 与 v(x,y)=c2 在相交点切线垂直。

Prove that the families u(x,y)=c1 and v(x,y)=c2 have perpendicular tangents at their intersection points.

读题注意Read this first

原题未说明正则相交点条件；解析中补上。

The original question omits the regular-intersection condition. The solution supplies it.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

证明两组等值线在正常交点处成直角。

Prove that the two level-curve families meet at right angles at regular points.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

梯度是等值线的法向量，也就是垂直于曲线的方向。法向量互相垂直，就能推出切线互相垂直。

A gradient is normal to a level curve. Perpendicular nonzero normals imply perpendicular tangents.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 写两法向量 ∇u=(ux,uy)、∇v=(vx,vy)。

    Write the normals ∇u=(ux,uy) and ∇v=(vx,vy).

  2. 算点积 uxvx+uyvy，用 C–R 替换成两项抵消。

    Compute uxvx+uyvy and substitute C–R so the terms cancel.

  3. 确认 f′≠0，使梯度非零，才可谈确定的切线；临界点单独处理。

    Check f′≠0 so the gradients are nonzero and tangents are defined. Handle critical points separately.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

法向量为零时，可以直接认定切线方向吗？

Can a zero normal vector directly determine a tangent direction?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不可以，必须另作局部分析。

No. Separate local analysis is needed.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

用等值线梯度作为法向量，比直接算斜率更稳妥。

Use gradients as normals to level curves. This also handles vertical tangents better than slopes do.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

用等值线梯度作为法向量，比直接算斜率更稳妥。

Use gradients as normals to level curves. This also handles vertical tangents better than slopes do.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

由 C–R，∇u·∇v=uxvx+uyvy=vyvx−vxvy=0。若 f′(z0)≠0，则两梯度都非零，隐函数定理保证局部是光滑等值线，法向量垂直意味着切向量也垂直。

C–R gives ∇u·∇v=uxvx+uyvy=vyvx−vxvy=0. If f′(z0)≠0, both gradients are nonzero. The implicit-function theorem then gives smooth local level curves. Perpendicular normals imply perpendicular tangents.

原题需要补充“相交点非临界且两曲线有确定切线”。例如常函数的等值集是整个区域，不能谈唯一切线；f=z2 在原点的等值集也有交叉支路。

The problem needs the additional condition that the intersection is regular and both curves have definite tangents. For a constant function, a level set can be the entire region and has no unique tangent. At the origin, the level sets of f=z2 also have crossing branches.

最终答案

Final answer

在 f′(z0)≠0 的正则相交点，两族曲线正交。

The families are orthogonal at regular intersection points where f′(z0)≠0.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

梯度内积为零 → 检查非零梯度 → 得出切线结论。

Show that the gradient dot product is zero → check that the gradients are nonzero → conclude that the tangents are perpendicular.

易错点

Common mistakes

不能在临界点无条件声称两条光滑曲线正交。

Do not claim unconditional orthogonality of two smooth curves at a critical point.

4 道主编号题4 numbered exercises
习题 1.4 · 1Exercise 1.4 · 1教材 p.26 / PDF p.35Textbook p.26 / PDF p.35

非解析被积函数的路径积分Path integrals of a nonanalytic integrand

计算 ∫02+iImzdz：(1) 0→2→2+i；(2) 直线段 0→2+i；(3) 0→1+i→2+i。

Evaluate ∫02+iImzdz: (1) 0→2→2+i; (2) the straight segment 0→2+i; (3) 0→1+i→2+i.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

沿三条不同路线分别累计积分，比较结果。

Accumulate the integral along three separate routes and compare the results.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

被积函数是 ℑz=y，不是解析函数，所以必须真的沿路线算。

The integrand is ℑz=y, which is not analytic. The path must be calculated explicitly.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 把 dz 写成 dx+idy，积分就成 ydx+iydy。

    Write dz=dx+idy, so the integrand becomes ydx+iydy.

  2. 第一条路线水平段 y=0，贡献零；竖直段 x=2，只积分 iydy。

    On the first route, the horizontal segment has y=0 and contributes zero. The vertical segment has x=2 and requires only iydy.

  3. 直线段可设 z=(2+i)t，0≤t≤1；折线路线逐段设参数再相加。

    For the straight route use z=(2+i)t, 0≤t≤1. Parameterize each segment of the other broken route and add.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

在 y=0 的水平段，被积函数是多少？

What is the integrand on a horizontal segment with y=0?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

零，因此那一段积分也是零。

Zero, so that segment contributes zero.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

写成 y(dx+idy)，分段积分。

Write the integral as y(dx+idy) and integrate one path segment at a time.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

写成 y(dx+idy)，分段积分。

Write the integral as y(dx+idy) and integrate one path segment at a time.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 水平段 y=0 贡献零；竖直段 z=2+it,0≤t≤1，贡献 ∫01itdt=i/2。

(1) The horizontal segment y=0 contributes zero. The vertical segment z=2+it,0≤t≤1 contributes ∫01itdt=i/2.

(2) z=(2+i)t，y=t,dz=(2+i)dt，积分为 (2+i)∫01tdt=1+i/2。

(2) Use z=(2+i)t and y=t,dz=(2+i)dt. The integral is (2+i)∫01tdt=1+i/2.

(3) 首段 z=(1+i)t，积分 (1+i)/2；次段 y=1,dz=dx,1≤x≤2，贡献 1。总和 3/2+i/2。

(3) On the first segment, z=(1+i)t, giving (1+i)/2. On the second, y=1,dz=dx,1≤x≤2, giving 1. Their sum is 3/2+i/2.

最终答案

Final answer

i/2, 1+i/2, 3/2+i/2。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

分段参数化 → 代入函数与微分 → 相加。

Parameterize each segment → substitute both the function and differential → add the contributions.

易错点

Common mistakes

Imz 不是解析函数，不能声称积分与路径无关。

Imz is not analytic, so the integral cannot be assumed to be independent of the path.

习题 1.4 · 2Exercise 1.4 · 2教材 p.26 / PDF p.35Textbook p.26 / PDF p.35

圆弧积分方向Orientation of circular arcs

计算 ∫C(z+2)/zdz：(1) 单位圆上半圆 0≤\argz≤π；(2) 下半圆 π≤\argz≤2π；(3) 逆时针单位圆。

Evaluate ∫C(z+2)/zdz: (1) the upper unit semicircle 0≤\argz≤π; (2) the lower semicircle π≤\argz≤2π; (3) the counterclockwise unit circle.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

用端点变化和转过的角度计算圆弧积分。

Use endpoint changes and the angle swept to calculate circular-arc integrals.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

把 (z+2)/z 拆成 1+2/z。这两项各有一个非常简单的几何意义。

Split (z+2)/z into 1+2/z. Each part has a simple geometric meaning.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 先拆积分：第一项是终点减起点。

    Split the integral. The first part is endpoint minus starting point.

  2. 对第二项设 z=eit，得到 dz/z=idt。

    For the second, set z=eit to obtain dz/z=idt.

  3. 上半圆用 t:0→π，下半圆用 t:π→2π；都是角度增加，不要误判方向。

    Use t:0→π on the upper arc and t:π→2π on the lower arc. Both increase the angle.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

逆时针绕单位圆一周，∫dz/z 是多少？

What is ∫dz/z for one counterclockwise unit-circle circuit?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

2πi。

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

拆成 1+2/z；第一项看终点差，第二项看角度增量。

Split it as 1+2/z. The first term depends on the endpoint difference; the second on the change in angle.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

拆成 1+2/z；第一项看终点差，第二项看角度增量。

Split it as 1+2/z. The first term depends on the endpoint difference; the second on the change in angle.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

令 z=eit，则 ∫Cdz=zend−zstart，∫C2dz/z=2iΔt。

Set z=eit. Then ∫Cdz=zend−zstart and ∫C2dz/z=2iΔt.

(1) 终点从 1 到 −1，故 −2+2πi。

(1) The endpoints go from 1 to −1, so −2+2πi.

(2) 从 −1 到 1，角度仍增加 π，故 2+2πi。

(2) The endpoints go from −1 to 1. The angle still increases by π, so 2+2πi.

(3) 终点差零，角度增量 2π，故 4πi。

(3) The endpoint difference is zero and the angle increases by 2π, so 4πi.

最终答案

Final answer

−2+2πi, 2+2πi, 4πi。

ML 积分估计The ML integral estimate

C 为第一象限内半径 2 的四分之一圆弧。证明 (1) |∫C(z−2)/(z4+1)dz|≤4π/15；(2) |∫C(z+4)/(z3−1)dz|≤6π/7。

C is a quarter-circle of radius 2 in the first quadrant. Prove (1) |∫C(z−2)/(z4+1)dz|≤4π/15; (2) |∫C(z+4)/(z3−1)dz|≤6π/7.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

不用算出积分，直接证明它不会超过题给大小。

Prove the integral cannot exceed a bound without finding its exact value.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

题目只要上界。用“函数最大可能大小 × 路程长度”，即 ML 估计。

Only an upper bound is requested. Use maximum possible integrand size times path length: the ML estimate.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 半径 2、四分之一圆的弧长是 L=π。

    A radius-two quarter-circle has length L=π.

  2. 第一问分子 |z−2|≤4，分母 |z4+1|≥16−1=15。

    In (1), |z−2|≤4 and |z4+1|≥16−1=15.

  3. 因此第一问 M≤4/15，再乘 L。第二问同样用 |z+4|≤6、|z3−1|≥7。

    Thus M≤4/15 and multiply by L. In (2), use |z+4|≤6 and |z3−1|≥7 in the same way.

Does the denominator need an upper or lower bound?

下界。分母越小，整个分式可能越大。

A lower bound: a smaller denominator can make the quotient larger.

The arc length is L=π. Bound the numerator with the triangle inequality and the denominator with the reverse triangle inequality.

解题思路

Plan

圆弧长 L=π；分子用三角不等式、分母用反三角不等式。

The arc length is L=π. Bound the numerator with the triangle inequality and the denominator with the reverse triangle inequality.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

在 C 上 |z|=2，长度 L=2·π/2=π。

On C we have |z|=2, and the length is L=2·π/2=π.

(1) |z−2|≤|z|+2=4，|z4+1|≥||z|4−1|=15，故 M≤4/15，|I|≤ML=4π/15。

(1) We have |z−2|≤|z|+2=4 and |z4+1|≥||z|4−1|=15. Hence M≤4/15 and |I|≤ML=4π/15.

(2) |z+4|≤6，|z3−1|≥8−1=7，故 |I|≤(6/7)π。

(2) We have |z+4|≤6 and |z3−1|≥8−1=7, hence |I|≤(6/7)π.

最终答案

Final answer

两上界依次为 4π/15,6π/7。

The two upper bounds are 4π/15,6π/7.

原函数、柯西定理与积分公式Antiderivatives, Cauchy's theorem, and the integral formula

计算：(1) ∫01+iz2dz；(2) ∫0π+2icos(z/2)dz；(3) ∮|z|=1/2cosz/(z2−1)dz；(4) ∮|z|=4sinz/(z2+9)dz；(5) ∮|z|=1cosz/zdz；(6) ∮|z−i|=1(z2−1)/(z2+1)dz。闭路均取正向。

Evaluate: (1) ∫01+iz2dz; (2) ∫0π+2icos(z/2)dz; (3) ∮|z|=1/2cosz/(z2−1)dz; (4) ∮|z|=4sinz/(z2+9)dz; (5) ∮|z|=1cosz/zdz; (6) ∮|z−i|=1(z2−1)/(z2+1)dz. All closed contours are positively oriented.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

先选最短的方法，再算每个复积分。

Choose the shortest valid method before calculating each complex integral.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

有起终点时先找原函数；闭路时先看圈内有没有分母零点。

For endpoint integrals, try an antiderivative. For closed contours, first locate denominator zeros relative to the contour.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第一问用原函数 z3/3，第二问用 2sin(z/2)，代终点减起点。

    Use z3/3 in (1) and 2sin(z/2) in (2), then subtract endpoint values.

  2. 第三问把 ±1 与半径 1/2 比较：都在外，积分零。

    In (3), compare ±1 with radius 1/2. Both are outside, so the integral is zero.

  3. 剩下闭路逐个筛圈内极点；第五问直接匹配 f(z)/z 的柯西公式，注意圆周都取正向。

    For the other contours, select enclosed poles individually. In (5), directly match the Cauchy formula for f(z)/z. All circles are positive.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

第三问的两个极点都在圆外，闭路积分是多少？

What is the third integral when both poles are outside its circle?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

零，因为整个圆内及圆周上解析。

Zero, since the integrand is analytic on and inside the circle.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

前两项用原函数；闭路先找内部极点再用柯西公式。

Use antiderivatives for the first two. For a closed contour, find the enclosed poles before applying Cauchy's formula.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

前两项用原函数；闭路先找内部极点再用柯西公式。

Use antiderivatives for the first two. For a closed contour, find the enclosed poles before applying Cauchy's formula.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 原函数 z3/3，所以 (1+i)3/3=(−2+2i)/3。

(1) An antiderivative is z3/3, so (1+i)3/3=(−2+2i)/3.

(2) 原函数 2sin(z/2)，端点代入得 2sin(π/2+i)=2cosh1。

(2) An antiderivative is 2sin(z/2). Substituting the endpoints gives 2sin(π/2+i)=2cosh1.

(3) 奇点 ±1 均在圆外，内部解析，积分为 0。

(3) Both singularities ±1 lie outside the circle. The integrand is analytic inside, so the integral is 0.

(4) 内部两极点 ±3i，留数分别为 sin(3i)/(6i)=sinh3/6 和 sin(−3i)/(−6i)=sinh3/6。积分 2πisinh3/3。

(4) The two enclosed poles are ±3i, with residues sin(3i)/(6i)=sinh3/6 and sin(−3i)/(−6i)=sinh3/6. The integral is 2πisinh3/3.

(5) 柯西公式直接给 2πicos0=2πi。

(5) Cauchy's formula directly gives 2πicos0=2πi.

(6) 圆内只有 i，−i 距圆心 2 在外。i 处留数 (i2−1)/(2i)=i，积分为 −2π。

(6) Only i is inside the circle. The point −i is at distance 2 from its center and lies outside. At i the residue is (i2−1)/(2i)=i, so the integral is −2π.

最终答案

Final answer

(−2+2i)/3, 2cosh1, 0, 2πisinh3/3, 2πi, −2π。

Try an antiderivative → count enclosed singularities → apply Cauchy's formula or residues.

Common mistakes

圆心不一定是原点；复三角函数不能按实三角有界性处理。

The circle need not be centered at the origin. Complex trigonometric functions do not share real trigonometric boundedness.

收敛半径与边界Radius of convergence and boundary points

确定下列幂级数的收敛半径和收敛区域：

Find the radius and region of convergence of each power series:

(1) ∑n=1∞(z−1)nn；

(1) ∑n=1∞(z−1)nn;

(2) ∑n=1∞nnzn；

(2) ∑n=1∞nnzn;

(3) ∑n=1∞(1−1n)n(z−i)n；

(3) ∑n=1∞(1−1n)n(z−i)n;

(4) ∑n=1∞n!nnzn。

(4) ∑n=1∞n!nnzn.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

先找收敛圆，再判圆周上的点能不能收敛。

Find the convergence disk, then decide which boundary points converge.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

题目给的是幂级数。系数的 n 次根控制半径；边界必须另外检查。

These are power series. The nth roots of their coefficients determine the radius; the boundary needs a separate test.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第一问先认出中心是 1、系数是 1/n，根值趋 1，得到半径 1。

    In (1), identify center one and coefficient 1/n. Its nth root tends to one, so the radius is one.

  2. 在边界写 z−1=eiθ。θ=0 是调和级数；其他角度可用 Dirichlet 判别。

    On the boundary, put z−1=eiθ. At θ=0 this is the harmonic series; use Dirichlet for other angles.

  3. 第二至四问也先求半径，再看边界通项是否趋零；不趋零就立刻判发散。

    For (2)–(4), also find the radius first, then test whether boundary terms approach zero. If not, the series diverges immediately.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

收敛半径为 1，能保证圆周也收敛吗？

Does radius one guarantee convergence on the circle?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不能。圆周要逐点判断。

No. Boundary points require separate tests.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

先算 R−1=lim sup|an|1/n；边界上先检查通项是否趋零。

First calculate R−1=lim sup|an|1/n. On the boundary, first check whether the terms tend to zero.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

半径由系数的根值或比值决定；圆周必须另作判断。

Use the coefficient root or ratio test for the radius. Check the convergence circle separately.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) |an|1/n=n−1/n→1，故以 1 为中心、R=1。内部绝对收敛，外部发散。边界写 z−1=eiθ：θ=0 时为调和级数，发散；θ≠0(mod2π) 时，∑n=1Neinθ 有界而 1/n 单调趋零，Dirichlet 判别给出条件收敛。故除 z=2 外的圆周点也收敛。

(1) Since |an|1/n=n−1/n→1, the center is 1 and R=1. The series converges absolutely inside and diverges outside. On the boundary write z−1=eiθ. At θ=0 it is a divergent harmonic series. For θ≠0(mod2π), ∑n=1Neinθ is bounded and 1/n decreases to zero. Dirichlet's test therefore gives conditional convergence. Thus every boundary point except z=2 also converges.

(2) |an|1/n=n→∞，故 R=0。仅 z=0 收敛（和为零）；任意非零 z 的通项模 (n|z|)n 不趋零。

(2) We have |an|1/n=n→∞, so R=0. Convergence occurs only at z=0, where the sum is zero. For every nonzero z, the term modulus (n|z|)n does not tend to zero.

(3) 当 n≥2，|an|1/n=1−1/n→1，故 R=1，中心为 i。边界上通项模 (1−1/n)n→e−1≠0，所以所有边界点发散。收敛区域严格为 |z−i|<1。

(3) When n≥2, |an|1/n=1−1/n→1. Thus R=1 with center i. At the boundary the term modulus is (1−1/n)n→e−1≠0, so every boundary point diverges. The convergence region is exactly |z−i|<1.

(4) an/an+1=(1+1/n)n→e，故 R=e。边界 |z|=e 上，由 Stirling 公式 n!~2πn(n/e)n 得通项模 n!en/nn~2πn，不趋零。因此收敛区域严格为 |z|<e。

(4) We have an/an+1=(1+1/n)n→e, so R=e. On the boundary |z|=e, Stirling's formula n!~2πn(n/e)n gives term modulus n!en/nn~2πn, which does not tend to zero. Therefore the convergence region is exactly |z|<e.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) R=1，|z−1|<1 绝对收敛；|z−1|=1,z≠2 条件收敛；z=2 发散。(2) R=0，只在 z=0 收敛。(3) R=1，收敛域 |z−i|<1。(4) R=e，收敛域 |z|<e。

(1) R=1; absolute convergence for |z−1|<1, conditional convergence for |z−1|=1,z≠2, and divergence at z=2. (2) R=0; convergence only at z=0. (3) R=1, with convergence region |z−i|<1. (4) R=e, with convergence region |z|<e.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

根值或比值求半径 → 圆内外结论 → 在边界代入 → 通项判别优先，必要时 Dirichlet 或 Stirling。

Use root or ratio test for the radius → state inside/outside behavior → substitute boundary points → test the terms first, then use Dirichlet or Stirling when needed.

易错点

Common mistakes

收敛半径不能直接决定圆周；第(3)系数本身趋非零，不能仅凭“半径为1”把边界算进来。

The radius alone does not settle the boundary. In part (3), the coefficients approach a nonzero value; a radius of one does not include its boundary.

(1) ez,z0=0；(2) sinz,z0=0；(3) coshz,z0=0；

(1) ez,z0=0; (2) sinz,z0=0; (3) coshz,z0=0;

(6) sinz/(1−z),z0=0; (7) 1/(z2+1),z0=1.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

围绕题目指定的点，把函数改写成正幂级数。

Write a positive-power series around the point specified in the question.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

中心不一定是零。先平移，让“离中心多远”成为新的变量。

The center need not be zero. Shift first so the new variable measures displacement from the center.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. “围绕中心展开”就是只使用 w=z−z0 的非负整数次幂。前3问中心都是0，直接写 ez、sinz、coshz 的标准级数，半径都是无穷。

    Expand using nonnegative integer powers of w=z−z0. In the first three parts the center is zero, so use the standard series for ez, sinz, and coshz, each with infinite radius.

  2. 第(4)问先写成 (z/4)/(1+z2/4)。把几何级数的小量选成 −z2/4，要求它的模小于1，因此 |z|<2。

    In part (4), write (z/4)/(1+z2/4). The geometric-series ratio is −z2/4. Its modulus must be below 1, giving |z|<2.

  3. 第(5)问中心不是0：设 w=z−i，拆成 −1/(i+w)+1/(i−1+w)。分别提常数 i 和 i−1，再按 w 展开；两个条件取交集 |w|<1。

    Part (5) is centered away from zero. Set w=z−i and split into −1/(i+w)+1/(i−1+w). Factor i and i−1 from the denominators, expand in w, and intersect the conditions to obtain |w|<1.

  4. 第(6)问把 sinz=z−z3/6+⋯ 与 1/(1−z)=1+z+z2+⋯ 相乘。每个目标幂次只收集次数相加等于它的项，例如三次项是 z3−z3/6。

    For part (6), multiply sinz=z−z3/6+⋯ by 1/(1−z)=1+z+z2+⋯. Collect terms with the same total degree: the cubic term is z3−z3/6.

  5. 第(7)问先设 w=z−1，再拆分母为 (z−i)(z+i) 后分别展开。收敛半径等于中心1到最近极点的距离 2；其他小问也用距离核验。

    For part (7), set w=z−1, factor the denominator as (z−i)(z+i), and expand its partial fractions. The nearest poles are distance 2 from center 1; use pole distances to check the other radii too.

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

定位中心及各极点半径 → 拆分 → 对每一分母选择小变量（z/a或a/z） → 写出严格不等式。

易错点

Common mistakes

Laurent级数不能跨过其收敛环域内的任何奇点；有负幂并不意味着所有外部区域都适用。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

极点列表 → 距离排序去重 → 列出最大圆域/环域 → 每域逐分母决定正幂或负幂。

易错点

同一半径上的两个极点只构成一条分界圆；移中心后所有距离都必须重新计算。

孤立奇点分类Classifying isolated singularities

找出有限远奇点并分类：

Find and classify the finite singularities:

(1) ez/(z2+9)；(2) sin[1/(z−1)]；(3) sinz/z；(4) z2e1/z。

(1) ez/(z2+9); (2) sin[1/(z−1)]; (3) sinz/z; (4) z2e1/z.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

找到奇点，并判断是能补上的洞、极点，还是本性奇点。

Locate singularities and distinguish removable holes, poles, and essential singularities.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

分类看局部展开的负幂：没有、有限个、无限个，对应三种类型。

Inspect the local negative powers: none, finitely many, or infinitely many give the three types.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第一问先找 z2+9 的零点，再检查指数分子在那里不为零。

    In (1), find zeros of z2+9 and check that the exponential numerator is nonzero there.

  2. 第三问展开 sinz=z−z3/6+⋯，除以 z 后没有负幂，可补值 1。

    In (3), expand sinz=z−z3/6+⋯. Division by z leaves no negative powers; add value one.

  3. 第二、四问展开复合正弦或指数，观察无限多负幂不会被有限乘方消掉。

    In (2) and (4), expand the composite sine or exponential. A finite power cannot remove infinitely many negative powers.

1。

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

In part (3), expand sine at zero. In part (4), multiplying by z2 shifts powers but cannot remove infinitely many negative powers.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

有理型看分母零点与分子消去；复合指数或三角函数看 Laurent 负幂项是否无限多。

For a rational-type expression, compare denominator zeros with numerator cancellation. For composite exponentials or trigonometric functions, check whether the Laurent series has infinitely many negative powers.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i)，e±3i≠0，所以 z=3i,−3i 都是一级极点，无其他有限奇点。

(1) Since z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i) and e±3i≠0, the points z=3i,−3i are simple poles. There are no other finite singularities.

(2) 令 w=z−1，

(2) Set w=z−1:

sin(1/w)=∑n≥0(−1)n(2n+1)!w−2n−1.
含无限多个负幂，
sin(1/w)=∑n≥0(−1)n(2n+1)!w−2n−1.
There are infinitely many negative powers, so
z=1 是本性奇点。
z=1 is an essential singularity.

(3) sinz/z=1−z2/6+z4/120−⋯，limz→0sinz/z=1。所以0是可去奇点，补定义 f(0)=1 后成为整函数。

(3) We have sinz/z=1−z2/6+z4/120−⋯ and limz→0sinz/z=1. Thus zero is removable. Defining f(0)=1 makes the function entire.

(4) z2e1/z=∑n≥0z2−n/n!，当 n≥3 有无限多负幂，因此0是本性奇点。

(4) The series is z2e1/z=∑n≥0z2−n/n!. For n≥3 it has infinitely many negative powers, so zero is essential.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) ±3i 为单极点；(2) 1 为本性奇点；(3) 0 可去，补值1；(4) 0 为本性奇点。

(1) ±3i are simple poles. (2) 1 is essential. (3) 0 is removable, with added value one. (4) 0 is essential.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

先查全部候选奇点 → 局部约分/展开 → 无负幂可去、有限主部极点、无限主部本性。

Find all candidate singularities → cancel or expand locally → no negative powers means removable; a finite principal part means a pole; an infinite principal part means essential.

易错点

Common mistakes

“分母为0”只是候选，需检查消去；有限次乘幂不能把本性奇点变成极点。

A zero denominator identifies only a candidate; check cancellation. Multiplying by a finite power cannot turn an essential singularity into a pole.

从 Laurent 系数求留数Residues from Laurent coefficients

求下列函数在 z=0 处的留数：

Find each residue at z=0:

(1) 1/(z+z2)；(2) zcos(1/z)；(3) (z−sinz)/z；

(1) 1/(z+z2); (2) zcos(1/z); (3) (z−sinz)/z;

(4) (eiaz−eibz)/z2；(5) cotz/z3；(6) z2exp(1/z)。

(4) (eiaz−eibz)/z2; (5) cotz/z3; (6) z2exp(1/z).

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

只取展开中 z−1 的系数，不必把整个级数算完。

Extract only the z−1 coefficient instead of computing the entire series.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

留数就是负一次幂的系数。先反推哪个原始项会变成负一次。

A residue is the coefficient of power minus one. Work backward to the original term that produces it.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 留数只要 z−1 的系数。第(1)问写 z−1(1−z+⋯)，常数1乘 z−1，所以留数是1。

    A residue is the coefficient of z−1. Part (1) is z−1(1−z+⋯); the constant 1 contributes residue 1.

  2. 第(2)问写 z[1−1/(2z2)+⋯]，目标项是 −1/(2z)，所以留数 −1/2。

    In part (2), write z[1−1/(2z2)+⋯]. The target term is −1/(2z), so the residue is −1/2.

  3. 第(3)问 z−sinz 从三次幂开始，除以 z 后没有负幂，留数0。第(4)问两个指数的常数相消，剩下的一次项 i(a−b)z 除以 z2，留数为 i(a−b)。

    In part (3), z−sinz starts at degree three; division by z leaves no negative powers, so the residue is zero. In part (4), constants cancel and the linear term i(a−b)z divided by z2 gives residue i(a−b).

  4. 第(5)问先看奇偶性：cotz 是奇函数，再除以奇函数 z3 后变成偶函数，只能有偶次幂，所以没有 z−1。

    For part (5), use parity: cotz and z3 are odd, so their quotient is even. Its Laurent series has only even powers and no z−1 term.

  5. 第(6)问外面有 z2，所以指数级数里要找 z−3。它来自 n=3，系数 1/3!，因此留数 1/6。

    Part (6) has an outside factor z2, so find z−3 in the exponential series. It occurs at n=3, with coefficient 1/3!, giving residue 1/6.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

第六问需要 e1/z 的哪一项？

Which term of e1/z is needed in part (6)?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

z−3/3!，乘 z2 后得到 z−1/6。

z−3/3!; multiplying by z2 gives z−1/6.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

第(5)利用 cotz=z−1−z/3−z3/45−⋯；检查除以 z3 后是否有 z−1。

For part (5), use cotz=z−1−z/3−z3/45−⋯ and check whether a z−1 term remains after division by z3.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

留数只取局部 Laurent 级数的 z−1 系数；不必展开整个级数。

A residue is just the z−1 coefficient in the local Laurent series. There is no need to compute every term.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 1/[z(1+z)]=z−1(1−z+z2−⋯)，所以留数为1。

(1) The series 1/[z(1+z)]=z−1(1−z+z2−⋯) gives residue one.

(2) zcos(1/z)=z−12z−1+124z−3−⋯，留数为 −1/2。

(2) From zcos(1/z)=z−12z−1+124z−3−⋯, the residue is −1/2.

(3) z−sinz=z3/6−z5/120+⋯，除以 z 后仅有非负幂，零点可去，留数为0。

(3) In z−sinz=z3/6−z5/120+⋯, dividing by z leaves only nonnegative powers. Zero is removable and its residue is zero.

(4) 常数项在两指数之差中消去：eiaz−eibz=i(a−b)z+O(z2)。除以 z2 后首项为 i(a−b)/z，留数为 i(a−b)；当 a=b 时函数恒零，此式仍成立。

(4) The constant terms of the two exponentials cancel: eiaz−eibz=i(a−b)z+O(z2). Dividing by z2 leaves first term i(a−b)/z, so the residue is i(a−b). If a=b, the function is identically zero and the formula still holds.

(5) 由正弦余弦级数相除得

(5) Divide the sine and cosine series to obtain

cotzz3=z−4−13z−2−145−2945z2−⋯.
所有幂次都是偶数，没有
cotzz3=z−4−13z−2−145−2945z2−⋯.
All powers are even. There is no
z−1，故留数为0。也可注意原函数为偶函数，其 Laurent 奇次系数全为0。
z−1 term, so the residue is zero. Alternatively, the function is even, so every odd Laurent coefficient vanishes.

(6) z2e1/z=∑n≥0z2−n/n!。令 2−n=−1 得 n=3，故留数 1/3!=1/6。

(6) Expand z2e1/z=∑n≥0z2−n/n!. Setting 2−n=−1 gives n=3. Thus the residue is 1/3!=1/6.

最终答案

Final answer

依次为 1,−12,0,i(a−b),0,16。

In order: 1,−12,0,i(a−b),0,16.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

把目标幂次对齐到 −1 → 只保留贡献该幂的项 → 相加；本性奇点同样可以有有限留数。

Identify which original term becomes −1 → keep only terms contributing that power → add their coefficients. An essential singularity can still have a finite residue.

易错点

Common mistakes

留数为零不代表没有奇点；第(5)有四阶极点，第(6)有本性奇点。

A zero residue does not mean no singularity. Part (5) has a fourth-order pole; part (6) has an essential singularity.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

留数定理只数圈内奇点。先筛位置，后算系数，能省掉圈外的计算。

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第一问分母因式分解，找出 0 和 1/2，都在单位圆内。

    In (1), factor the denominator to find zero and 1/2. Both lie inside the unit circle.

In part (5), the center is three and only z=3 is enclosed. In part (6), a second-order pole can still have zero residue.

−2πi/e。
−2πi/e.

(5) 各候选极点为0、±3；相对圆心3的距离为3、0、6，所以只有3在内，且为单极点：

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

画圆并筛极点 → 单极点用分子/分母导数 → 高阶极点用导数或局部级数 → 留数求和乘方向因子。

Draw the circle and select poles → for simple poles use numerator divided by denominator derivative → for higher orders use derivatives or local series → sum residues and apply the orientation factor.

易错点

Common mistakes

积分不只看最高阶主部；真正决定积分的是一次负幂。负向圆周需把全部结果取负。

The highest-order principal-part term does not determine the integral. The power minus one does. Reverse the sign for a negatively oriented circle.

In part (5), infinity is not an isolated singularity, so the instruction “including infinity” does not apply there. List the finite-pole residues and state that the residue at infinity is undefined.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

无穷远留数不是直接代入无穷大；它是外域 z−1 系数的相反数，而且要求无穷远孤立。

The residue at infinity is the negative exterior z−1 coefficient, not a substitution of infinity. Infinity must first be isolated.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

In part (5), simplify to 2z/cos2z. Infinitely many poles approach infinity, so “take the negative sum of all finite residues” is not applicable.
